title: TipsGoalUpdatedPayload
description: tips.goal.updated v1 (OpenVibe.Tips server/domain/goals.js changed). A goal was created, edited or closed, or its settled total moved (a contribution, the contribution that reached it, a reversal). Envelope: subject { type: goal, id: tgoal_…, revision }, visibility internal, priority important, actor service:tips.

current_amount.description: Settled total including any amount carried over from Live.

interaction_id.description: The interaction behind a contribution, reached or reversal change; null otherwise.
